judgment.rationale: The report identifies Quick Accent on Windows 11 25H2 from the Store and says the character chart fails to appear during key-plus-arrow input.
evidence: Issue names Quick Accent, Windows 11 25H2, and Store installation.
Symptom is the missing character chart when using activation key plus arrow.
judgment.recommended_action: Reproduce the key/arrow sequence and check whether input is handled before the overlay appears.

fix_assessment.rationale: PowerAccent handles keyboard events separately from delayed toolbar display; visibility/input mismatch is plausible.

issue_context.summary: Quick Accent’s character chart sometimes does not appear during the key-plus-arrow activation sequence on Windows 11 25H2.
known_information: The report names Windows 11 25H2 and Store installation.
No discussion comments or additional reproduction details are present.
inferences: A timing issue between keyboard hook and delayed overlay display is plausible.
issue_context.analysis: PowerAccent receives show-toolbar and next-character events separately from delayed UI display. Reproduction can test whether input is handled before the overlay appears.
initial_investigation: Inspected src/modules/poweraccent/PowerAccent.Core/PowerAccent.cs for keyboard events and delayed display state.

actions.label: Approve Keep Quick Accent navigation and toolbar visibility in sync
Reproduce locally
actions.note: The report provides a focused sequence that can be verified without asking the reporter to repeat supplied evidence.

reproduce.title: Verify Quick Accent chart with key-plus-arrow input
reproduce.version_requirement: Windows 11 25H2 and reported Store build or current equivalent
prerequisites: Quick Accent enabled with its usual activation key and supported input language.
setup: Open a text field where Quick Accent input is accepted.
steps: Press and hold a letter that has accent choices.
Use the arrow-key navigation sequence while the toolbar is opening.
Repeat if a longer display delay is configured and note whether the chart appears before the arrow is handled.
reproduce.expected_result: The chart should be visible before arrow navigation changes selection; if not displayed, input should not be silently consumed.

proposed_fixes.title: Keep Quick Accent navigation and toolbar visibility in sync
plan: Trace key-plus-arrow events through PowerAccentKeyboardService and the delayed display state.
Avoid consuming navigation before a valid toolbar is shown, or cancel the pending gesture if display fails.
Add a regression test for input while the toolbar is opening.
proposed_fixes.root_cause: The keyboard hook may consume arrow navigation while the accent toolbar has not become visible.
verification: Repeat the key-plus-arrow sequence and confirm the chart appears before navigation is consumed.

confidence.rationale: Current code separates keyboard events and delayed display; the report fits a timing mismatch but lacks trigger/timing detail.
